infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ThaLinq requires access to your photo library to allow you to upload a profile picture and share photos of events or parties within your groups.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ThaLinq requires access to your camera to allow you to take and post photos directly to your party groups and update your profile picture.
